title: What Would Your Essences Be?
dek: Absorb three essences, form a confluence, become an adventurer. Eight questions to find your build.
intro: In He Who Fights With Monsters, adventurers absorb three essences, and the combination forms a fourth: the confluence. Your result is a three-essence build and the confluence it points toward.
spoiler_boundary: Book 1. Named confluences are only the canonical book 1 builds of Jason Asano and Humphrey Geller.
disclaimer: Unofficial fan quiz. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Shirtaloon (Travis Deverell) or his publishers. Go read the books.

outcomes.name: Dark, Blood and Sin → Doom
outcomes.tagline: You win slowly, horribly and on purpose.
outcomes.description: Shadows, bleeding and curses that punish anyone who crosses you, all feeding into the Doom confluence. It's the same build Jason Asano made infamous: stack afflictions, stay slippery, and let your enemies fall apart on their own schedule. Monsters learn to fear you. So do some adventurers.
outcomes.share_text: My HWFWM essences: Dark, Blood and Sin → Doom. I win slowly, horribly and on purpose. What would yours be?

outcomes.name: Might, Wing and Magic → Dragon
outcomes.tagline: Hit very hard. Preferably from above.
outcomes.description: Raw strength, flight and spellcraft, combining into the Dragon confluence, the same build as Humphrey Geller. You're the front line and the air support at the same time: first into the fight, last one standing, and very hard to argue with.
outcomes.watch_out: MCs who never step up to the front.
outcomes.share_text: My HWFWM essences: Might, Wing and Magic → Dragon. I hit very hard, preferably from above. What would yours be?

outcomes.name: Swift, Wind and Balance
outcomes.tagline: Nobody has managed to hit you yet.
outcomes.description: Speed, moving air and perfect poise. Your confluence would lean toward untouchable movement: you're everywhere and nowhere, and every attack finds only the space you used to be in. Fights with you in them look like choreography.
outcomes.share_text: My HWFWM essences: Swift, Wind and Balance. Nobody has managed to hit me yet. What would yours be?

outcomes.name: Shield, Growth and Renewal
outcomes.description: Barriers, buffs and healing. Your confluence would lean toward keeping a whole team alive and thriving: you make everyone around you stronger, tougher and harder to kill. The party would be lost without you, and they know it.
outcomes.share_text: My HWFWM essences: Shield, Growth and Renewal. Nobody dies on my watch. What would yours be?

outcomes.name: Fire, Earth and Potent
outcomes.tagline: You don't win fights. You end them.
outcomes.description: Flame, stone and raw amplification. Your confluence would lean toward slow, devastating, heavily armored magic: you plant your feet, the ground starts to glow, and the battlefield stops being a place anyone else wants to stand.
outcomes.share_text: My HWFWM essences: Fire, Earth and Potent. I don't win fights, I end them. What would yours be?

outcomes.name: Magic, Rune and Balance
outcomes.tagline: An hour of preparation. One second of victory.
outcomes.description: Spellcraft, rituals and equilibrium. Your confluence would lean toward preparation and control: circles drawn in advance, rules of magic bent to your purpose, and a fight that was decided before anyone threw a punch.
outcomes.share_text: My HWFWM essences: Magic, Rune and Balance. An hour of preparation, one second of victory. What would yours be?

outcomes.name: Trap, Adept and Swift
outcomes.tagline: The fight was over before they walked in.
outcomes.description: Traps, technique and speed. Your confluence would lean toward control of the battlefield: you choose where the fight happens, you arrive first, and the enemy discovers the plan one tripwire at a time.
outcomes.watch_out: Heroes who charge in without a plan.
outcomes.share_text: My HWFWM essences: Trap, Adept and Swift. The fight was over before they walked in. What would yours be?

outcomes.name: Sword, Adept and Balance
outcomes.tagline: The best technique in the room.
outcomes.description: Blades, skill and poise. Your confluence would lean toward pure technique: no tricks, no curses, just a weapon in the right hands and years of practice behind every cut. Other adventurers stop to watch you train.
outcomes.share_text: My HWFWM essences: Sword, Adept and Balance. The best technique in the room. What would yours be?

questions.prompt: Your first monster fight as a new adventurer. How do you want to win?

options.label: Stack curses and poisons, then watch it fall apart.
Hit it very hard, preferably from above.
Be somewhere else every time it swings.
Make sure nobody on my team gets hurt.

questions.prompt: You can awaken one new ability. Pick:

options.label: A ritual that takes an hour to set up and ends the fight in a second.
Wings. Obviously.
A burst of speed nobody can follow.
An attack that melts the ground they're standing on.

questions.prompt: Which contract do you take from the notice board?

options.label: Hunt the monster everyone else is afraid of.
A duel with a rival adventurer, for bragging rights.
Escort a caravan and bring everyone home.
Investigate a strange magical site nobody understands.
Smile. I set traps here an hour ago.
Plant my feet and turn the ground into lava.
Slip through the gap and hit them from behind.
Let them come. Everything that touches me starts to wither.

questions.prompt: Between contracts, you spend your time...

options.label: Studying magic theory until the candles run out.
Checking on everyone and restocking the healing potions.
Scouting the next dungeon and mapping every corridor.
Training until my armor is too hot to touch.

questions.prompt: What's your job on the team?

options.label: Front line. Take the hits, deal the hits.
Support caster. I make everyone else's magic work better.
The one with the best technique in the room.
Healer and barrier. Nobody dies on my watch.

questions.prompt: A rival adventurer challenges you. You...

options.label: Accept, and bring overwhelming force.
Accept, and make it a show.
Accept, and pick the battlefield myself.
Accept. Steel to steel, fair and square.

questions.prompt: What do the bards sing about you?

options.label: The adventurer the monsters are afraid of.
The one nobody ever managed to hit.
The one who won before the fight started.
The finest blade of their generation.
The one who brought everyone home.
